name: Eastern Palace lobby

points.label: entry_spawn
points.notes: EasternPalaceEntry load; south alcove, facing the overworld door

points.label: railing_gap
points.notes: 16px east of spawn x slips north of the south-alcove railing

points.label: north_wall_nook
points.notes: Closed center-shutter face. UP here does not room-change until the pot switch opens it.

points.label: center_pot
points.notes: Floor south of the center 0x71 pot at (4856,6504). The exit hook walks UP onto it, lifts, and throws.

points.label: north_door_approach
points.notes: Hold UP into 0xB9 after the hall popos are dead. The mouth reopens then. A push already at y≈6204 wedges.

doors.label: south_to_overworld
doors.notes: Isolated 2026-09-21 from EasternPalaceEntry. Spawn is already on the south door; DOWN → OW 0x1E (3920,1579) module 0x09. Probe settle was (3920,1583).

doors.label: north_to_0xb9
doors.notes: Isolated from EasternPalaceEntry. Lift the center pot. Crossing the center shutter closes the north mouth until the 0x4F popos are dead, then hold UP from y=6248. Not natural. x>=4876 stays in 0xC9.

notes: Confirmed $A0 == 0xC9 on the live pin (hypothesis matched).
South alcove is a 512-cell south quadrant (local y 304–472). Popos sit in the north hall (y≈6224) behind the alcove wall.
Center pot 0x71 hides the 0x23 switch. After it opens, slot-1 north (type 0x18) is the forward door to 0xB9. Left and right 0x80 mouths are dead ends. south_to_overworld stays the backtrack.
